verdict.rationale: DBOS is an open-source library that checkpoints all workflow and step state into your own Postgres database, with no separate orchestration server. Your data already sits in a standard, open database you control, and the CLI can list workflows as JSON. Conductor and the Console can also be self-hosted, so leaving does not depend on a proprietary service. Missing for 10: documented export/migration procedures, explicit export of DBOS-managed Conductor data (audit logs, metrics, settings), and independent hands-on corroboration of exiting.
